title: Emote bot
description: Configuration for the Emote catalog bot: say an emote's name in chat and your avatar performs it; permitted users can trigger a room-wide emote wave.

emote_on_say.title: Emote on say
emote_on_say.description: A user says an emote name or alias in chat and their avatar performs it.

cooldown_s.title: Per-user cooldown (seconds)
cooldown_s.description: Minimum wait between one user's emote triggers.

disabled_emotes.title: Blocked emotes
disabled_emotes.description: Emote names the bot will ignore in this room.

emote_all.title: Emote all
emote_all.description: "all <emote>" makes everyone in the room perform it as a staggered wave.

list_command.title: Emote list command
list_command.description: "emotes" whispers a paginated list of available emote names.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: "loop <emote>" repeats that emote until the user says "stop" or leaves the room — the AFK-dance feature.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off by default — the heaviest-load v1 feature (specs/bots/emote.md) and not yet tuned against real platform limits.

interval_s.title: Repeat interval (seconds)
interval_s.description: How often the looped emote re-triggers.

max_concurrent_loopers.title: Max concurrent loopers
max_concurrent_loopers.description: Caps how many users can loop at once in this room.

max_duration_s.title: Max loop duration (seconds)
max_duration_s.description: Safety auto-stop if a user forgets to say "stop" (e.g. disconnects without a clean leave).

cooldown_s.title: Per-user start cooldown (seconds)
cooldown_s.description: Minimum wait between one user starting new loops.
